user.title: Recetteur MCP
user.description: **Internal** address of the Recetteur add-on's MCP server: `http://<add-on hostname>:8100/mcp`. The hostname is on the add-on's Info page. The `mcp_token` option must be set in the add-on, otherwise its MCP server is disabled.

done.title: URL to give to Claude
done.description:
In Claude, add a custom connector pointing to:

`{url}`

with the request header `Authorization: Bearer <your mcp_token>`.

This address contains a secret: do not share it. It goes through your Home Assistant remote access (Nabu Casa): no port to open.

error.cannot_connect: The MCP server does not answer at this address. Check the hostname, that the add-on is running and that mcp_token is set.
